text: Ellie starts at the architecture firm sometime next week. She's nervous about the commute more than the job itself.

Spoke to Hugo on the phone. His dad is finally retiring at the end of the month after thirty-one years at the depot, and the family are throwing him a surprise lunch the weekend after. Hugo's sister is organising it and wants everyone to bring a photo from his early days there. I should get a card that Hugo can pass on, and dig out that picture from the open day.
Kavya has a second interview with the council on Thursday. Remind me to text her good luck the night before.
Petra's leaving do is off. She's been asked to stay on until the new manager is hired, so probably early March now.
Ignacio got the promotion! Team lead from November. Must send him congratulations.
Coffee with Jess. Her brother Kieran has applied for the paramedic course and hears back over the summer. She says he's pretending not to care but checks his email constantly.
Need to pick up dry cleaning and post the parcel before Friday.
Ravi mentioned he's been vegetarian since the spring. Worth remembering for the dinner.
Wiremu had his final day at the school yesterday. Lots of tears apparently. Ask him how the send-off went.

Asha and her partner are both starting new jobs the same week in January, which she said will be chaos with the kids. Her mum is coming to stay the week before to help out with the school runs, and her brother has offered to take the youngest on Wednesdays. Asha's new place is in the city centre, so she'll be leaving at seven most days.
Gintaras is applying for a transfer to the Vilnius office. Interview sometime next week, and if it goes well he'd move over the summer.
Eamon's daughter has her first day at the bakery on Saturday. He's more nervous than she is.

Rang Eli about the interview. He said it went fine but they asked a lot about management experience, which he doesn't really have. He's worried that sank it. They're seeing two more candidates on Friday and will let everyone know by the end of the month. If it's a no, he's thinking of doing the leadership course his old boss recommended over the summer.
Björn has a new puppy, a spaniel called Pepper. He's taking a week off work afterwards to settle her in.
Jasmine got the job at the hospital pharmacy! She starts early March. Her sister Irina is driving her down that morning because it's a long way.
Haruto retired last Friday. I should call him next week and see how he's finding it.
Rhys and Mei are moving to Bristol at the end of the summer because Mei's been offered a lectureship there.

Theo has been struggling since the restructure. His boss keeps adding to his workload, two of his colleagues have already left, and he's not sleeping well. He says he's started looking at other jobs but feels too drained to apply. His girlfriend wants him to talk to HR. Check in with him sometime next week.
Javier loves jazz and keeps talking about getting a proper record player. Good gift idea for his birthday in May.
Mai's interview at the studio was cancelled; they gave the role to someone internal. She's disappointed but already applying elsewhere.
Kenji Nakamura from the old team is leaving for a startup. His leaving drinks are on the 14th, and he said the day after he's flying to Osaka for two weeks.
Ava's mum has her retirement party on Saturday. Ava is doing a speech and is terrified about it. Don't forget to message her that morning.
Beatriz is a nurse on the cardiac ward. She does nights most of the month.
Chidi has his probation review next Tuesday. He thinks it'll be fine but his manager has been a bit cold lately. Ask him how it went afterwards.
Suzanne's husband was made redundant last week. She's putting on a brave face but they're worried about the mortgage. I should drop round with something.

Lunch with Claire and Sophie. Claire is going back to work after maternity leave in early March, and Sophie is covering her role until then. Sophie isn't sure whether she'll stay on in the team afterwards or go back to finance.
Ellie's first week went well. She said her manager, Mrs Kaur, took her for lunch on the first day and showed her round.
Tamar has a panel interview for the curator post on Monday and a presentation to prepare for the day before. Remind me to ask Tamar how it went.
Hugo mentioned he's training for the half marathon in April.
Kavya got it! She starts at the council sometime next month. Her husband Ravi is taking her out for dinner on Friday to celebrate.
Book the car in for its MOT. Sometime before the end of the month.
Petra's dad has his knee operation in early March and she's taking a fortnight off to look after him. She'll be back the week after he's home.

Spoke to Ignacio's wife at the school gate. He's starting the new role on Monday and she says he's been up every night preparing slides for his first team meeting. They're also expecting their second in the summer, so the timing is a bit mad. She asked if I'd take him for a pint the Friday after to make him switch off.
Jess is thinking about leaving teaching. She's got an application in for a policy job and hears sometime next week. I need to remember to ask her about it.
Kieran passed his driving test this morning!
Wiremu's son has a trial with the youth academy over the summer. Wiremu says he's beside himself with excitement.
Asha said her boss is retiring at Christmas and she's been asked to apply for the role. She's not sure she wants it.
Message from Gintaras: the Vilnius interview went well and they'll let him know by the end of the week.
I start the new job on the 3rd. Need to sort out a desk chair and a decent bag before then.
Eli and Kieran are both up for the same promotion. Awkward. Eli doesn't know Kieran applied, so don't mention it.
Björn's sister Mai is getting married in early June. He's best man and has already started worrying about the speech. Must send him the old photos from uni that week.
Caught up with Jasmine and Irina. Irina's been working at the bookshop since the summer and loves it. Jasmine is still settling into the pharmacy; the shifts are long but she likes the team.
Haruto's granddaughter graduates from nursing school at the end of the month. He's flying out the day before and staying for a week afterwards. Get him a card for her before he goes.

Rhys had his exit interview today. He said it was uncomfortable but he's glad it's done. His last day is the following Friday, and the team are taking him out for curry that evening. Mei is coming too. After that he's got a month off before Bristol, which he plans to spend painting the new place.
Mei's lectureship starts early September, so they're house hunting in Bristol sometime next week.
Theo says he's allergic to shellfish. Keep that in mind for the team dinner.

Dinner at Javier's. His brother Theo got the apprenticeship with the electrician, and their mum is over the moon. Theo starts the week after Easter. Javier said he's going to buy him a proper toolbox.
Remind me to ring Kenji when he's back from Osaka to hear about the new job.
Ava's speech went brilliantly by the sound of it. Her mum cried. Send Ava a quick well done.

Beatriz has applied for the charge nurse post. Interview sometime next week. She's been stressed about it all month because her manager, Dr Shah, is on the panel and they don't always get on. She's asked me to run through some practice questions with her on Sunday. I'm bringing pastries.
Chidi passed his probation. Relief all round.
Suzanne's husband has an interview with the water board at the end of the month. She asked me not to mention it to anyone at work.

Long call with Sophie. Her dad has decided to retire early, which nobody saw coming, and her mum is not thrilled because she thought they'd agreed to wait until he turned sixty-five. Meanwhile her brother Hugo has just been offered a job in Edinburgh and is deciding over the weekend. Sophie thinks he'll take it. She said the whole family is meeting up for Sunday lunch the weekend after to talk everything through. I should check in with her after that.
Claire's first day back went fine. The baby, though, cried for an hour at nursery that morning, and she felt awful.
Tamar didn't get the curator job but they've asked her to apply for an assistant role that opens in early March. She's annoyed but will probably go for it.
Groceries, bin day, and call the dentist about moving my appointment to sometime next week.
Kavya's first day at the council is Monday. She's nervous about the open-plan office. Don't forget to send her a message that evening to see how it went.
Petra loves gardening and has started an allotment with her neighbour. She grows far too many courgettes.

Ignacio's team lead role was put on hold because of the budget freeze, so the November start is off for now. He's taking it well, considering. HR told him it might be revisited early next year, but he's not holding his breath. His wife thinks he should start looking elsewhere.

Met Irina's partner, Gintaras, for the first time. He works in logistics and is about to start a new contract in early March. Irina says he's a bit anxious about it because the last place let him go after three months. Remind me to ask him how the first week goes.
